**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What the document has:** SFJ's only bespoke warranty is the funding warranty in § 13.5 (p0739). SFJ's performance standards live elsewhere as covenants only — § 3.1.4 (material compliance with Applicable Laws) and § 3.1.5 (Commercially Reasonable Efforts to conduct the Clinical Trials per the SFJ SOPs). Nothing warrants the quality of the "SFJ Services" (§ 1.1.169: global CRO oversight and execution of the trials in the European Clinical Trial Countries, Japan and China), and no warranty remedy exists.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** even the fallback position requires a conformance warranty with a re-perform/repair/refund remedy. Here there is none, and § 13.6.2's all-caps disclaimer carves out only what is "SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13" — where no SFJ performance warranty appears.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** amended § 13.5 into (a) funding and (b) a workmanlike-performance warranty for the SFJ Services and SFJ-conducted trial activities (SFJ SOPs, Protocol, Applicable Law including GCP/ICH), with re-performance at SFJ's sole cost, excluded from Development Costs, and non-exclusive of other remedies. Placing it inside Article 13 means it automatically sits within the § 13.6.2 carve-out, so no separate edit to the disclaimer was needed — the smallest change that reaches the preferred position.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no fixed warranty duration was proposed, since these are continuous trial-conduct obligations rather than discrete deliverables.
